verdict.rationale: Runway documents a first-party Characters feature with avatars and custom voices, plus custom voice clones on its plans, so presenter-style avatar output exists in the product. However, Characters is described as real-time conversational sessions, and the general video models are text-to-video rather than script-to-presenter tools, so the paste-a-script flow is not shown. Missing for 10: a documented script-to-presenter video workflow, a stock avatar library, custom avatar creation from a likeness, lip-synced rendered video output, and any hands-on corroboration.
